screen.captcha.config.title: Evil CAPTCHA Server Config
config.captcha.lethal.description: Players die when failing a captcha a certain amount of times
config.captcha.lives.description: [If Lethal is enabled] The amount of tries Players have to solve a captcha before getting killed
config.captcha.explosive.description: [If Lethal is enabled] Players explode violently when dying from captchas (WARNING!! DESTRUCTIVE!)
config.captcha.validation_expiration.des: Whether captchas should appear based on a semi-random timer
config.captcha.expiration_delay_min.desc: [If expiration is enabled] The Minimum amount of ticks until a player will be forced to do another captcha
config.captcha.expiration_delay_max.desc: [If expiration is enabled] The Maximum amount of ticks until a player will be forced to do another captcha
config.captcha.not_easy.description: Prevents "easy" captchas (or un-failable ones) from showing up
config.captcha.constant_increase_rate.de: The amount by which the global difficulty should be increased every Constant Difficulty++ Interval
config.captcha.constant_increase_interva: The Interval (in Ticks) of the global difficulty being increased by the Constant Difficulty++ Value
config.captcha.login_captcha.description: Whether joining this world should trigger a captcha
config.captcha.respawn_captcha.descripti: Whether respawning should trigger a captcha
config.captcha.mining_captcha.descriptio: Whether mining ores should have a certain chance of triggering a captcha
config.captcha.crafting_captcha.descript: Whether crafting items should have a minimal chance of triggering a captcha
config.captcha.loot_captcha.description: Whether opening new Loot Chests should trigger a captcha
config.captcha.captcha_rewards.descripti: Whether successfully completing a captcha should reward players using a customizable loot table (NOTE: The Loot Table is empty per default! If you want to use this feature, use a datapack to change it.)
